title: Samsung foundry profit rebound may come in 3Q26 as 2nm orders rise 130%
content: Samsung Electronics' foundry business may return to profit as early as the third quarter of 2026, ahead of its previous target of late 2026 to 2027, as improving yields, larger orders, and stronger demand for high-bandwidth memory base dies lift utilization, according to Korean media reports.

title: Adata, Macronix report record May revenue amid rising memory demand, prices
content: Memory manufacturers have reported revenue gains in May 2026, with Adata Technology posting NT$12.94 billion (approx. US$410.88 million), setting a new record for the third consecutive month. Macronix International also reached a single-month record high of NT$6.26 billion.

title: ELAN sees drone and AI PC push reshaping revenue mix
content: Taiwanese fabless chipmaker ELAN said its second-quarter 2026 outlook suggests revenue will hold near first-quarter levels, even as the company expands beyond PC orders into drones, AI PCs, and optical modules. The company also said drone-related revenue could grow multiple times over the next two years.

title: Chief Telecom eyes stronger second half on AI data center demand
content: Chief Telecom reported May 2026 revenue of NT$334 million (US$10.61 million), down 25.22% from a year earlier, but the decline largely reflected a high comparison base created by one-off income booked in the same month last year.

title: SuperAlloy targets semiconductor supply chain with recycled aluminum push
content: SuperAlloy reported that rising demand from global luxury and supercar manufacturers, alongside green procurement policies, drove higher sales of recycled aluminum in May, lifting group momentum into the first half of 2026. The company said consolidated revenue for May reached NT$635 million (US$20.14 million) — up 6.7% from April and 18.74% from the same month in 2025. title: VinFast spins off manufacturing arm, deepens Nvidia tie-up in autonomy push
content: During its first quarter 2026 earnings call, VinFast Auto Ltd. unveiled a series of significant corporate moves, including a transition in board leadership, a major restructuring of its manufacturing assets, and the expansion of high-tech partnerships focused on autonomous mobility. These developments signal the company's shift toward a "capital-light" business model that prioritizes research and development (R&D) and brand growth over capital-intensive manufacturing.

title: VinFast revenue rises 42%, but losses widen sharply in 1Q26
content: Vietnam-based electric vehicle maker VinFast reported strong revenue and delivery growth in the first quarter of 2026, but its financial results showed that losses continued to widen significantly as the company pursues aggressive global expansion.
